description: Use when an agent must compare DeFi lending rates. Input: chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum), optional protocol (aave-v3, compound-v3, morpho, moonwell) and asset (USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, wstETH…). Output: JSON per market supply/borrow APY, utilization, supplied/borrowed, TVL USD; chain=ethereum adds wstETH/cbETH/rETH staking rates (7-day APR). Read from contracts, no yield API. Example: ?chain=ethereum&asset=USDC Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

asset.description: Comma list of the chain's assets (Base: USDC, WETH, cbBTC, wstETH, cbETH, EURC; Ethereum: USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, wstETH; Arbitrum: USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, wstETH). Bad value → 400 before payment

chain.description: Chain (default base). Moonwell is Base only; Morpho vaults Base and Ethereum. Bad value → 400 before payment

protocol.description: Comma list of aave-v3, compound-v3, morpho, moonwell (default all on the chain). Bad value → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: defi_yields
title: DeFi lending rates (supply/borrow APY) and TVL on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum: Aave v3, Compound v3, Morpho, Moonwell
